review_description: We had an outstanding experience with Blue Tech Solar and could not recommend them more highly. After a disappointing start with another installer, we found Blue Tech through SolarQuotes — and the difference was night and day.From the first call, their communication, professionalism, and attention to detail were exceptional. They took the time to properly assess our site and came up with a creative solution for our battery location that every other company said was “impossible.” Instead of taking shortcuts, they went the extra mile — even trenching to connect our EV charger neatly and safely.We installed 20 Trina 440W panels (8.8kW) with a 16.3kWh Sungrow battery, inverter, and EV charger, all perfectly integrated in one app.If you want a team that listens, solves problems, and truly cares about the quality of their work, Blue Tech Solar is the one to choose. A genuine family business with integrity, expertise, and heart.

The quote process was seamless. Blue Tech conducted a site visit and provided great advice and options regarding the location of the batteries and solar panels. The quote was comprehensive and easy to follow. The installation was amazing. The whole job was completed same day. The team were professional, courteous and efficient and cleaned up really well before leaving. The service provided by Blue Tech was outstanding, they organised everything, grid connection, commissioned the system and initial system setup and even some basic training on the Sigenergy app.We couldn't be happier with Blue Tech. James & Terese not only run the business, they were the people we dealt with from go to whoa.
Terese and James were so easy to deal with and very courteous. They knew their subject matter very well and looked after us all the way. The system is up and working very well

Very honest sales process; not overstating or overselling what can be achieved, with a focus on quality and house health.Installation was punctual and professional, with cabling very neat and tidy.Post installation customer service has been exemplary with prompt follow up on any questions and concerns.

I’m extremely impressed with the work James and his team did installing our solar system and batteries. The installation was neat, minimalist, and thoughtfully executed — they took great care to hide cables or run them through the most discreet paths possible.James has also been excellent with post-install support, always quick to respond to my questions and proactive in making sure our setup is running as efficiently as possible.I’d happily recommend James and his team to any of my friends or family.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Blue Tech Energy for the installation of a solar battery. Their team was exceptionally professional and reliable throughout the entire process. From the initial consultation to final installation, they demonstrated expertise and attention to detail. It was a seamless experience, and I truly appreciate their commitment to customer satisfaction.  I highly recommend Blue Tech Energy for anyone considering solar battery installation.

After receiving the 3 installers from Solar Quotes I contacted each of them. One installer gave a quote using Google that covered my entire roof in solar panels, bullnose roof over verandah included! Another it seemed just wanted my money. James from Blue Tech took the time to visit ask about what we expected and gave an honest review of what we could expect from our solar installation.James recommended what panels and battery should be installed. The quoted price was competitive and any questions that I had were asked were answered promptly by Terese.Installation of panels took place and battery installed later, to take advantage of the Government rebate which Blue Tech managed for us. The site was left neat and tidy by James and his boys.Blue Tech continue to monitor the install to make sure we are getting the most out of our system.If you are looking for a new or updating of your solar system. Contact Blue Tech I highly recommend them.

If you would like excellent service, competitive pricing and top drawer solar installers at your house then Blue Tech Energy NSW is your go to solar energy supplier.From the quotation stage to the Installation stage including coaching baby boomers how to use the solar app you will find Blue Tech Energy NSW are excellent in all aspects of solar energy.Many thanks James & Terese
